description: Implement successive halving by running short restarts and then refining the top performers.

Replace the symmetry-constrained start idea with a simpler two-phase refinement because implementing symmetry-constrained optimization with different variable counts is complex to do correctly within the time limit.
Implement penalty continuation using L-BFGS-B before refining with SLSQP to reach a better feasible starting point.
Implement a remove-and-reinsert strategy by deleting the smallest circle and attempting to insert a larger one at a sampled point.
Implement a remove-and-reinsert strategy to improve the packing by removing the smallest circles and reinserting them at high-clearance locations.
Implement a two-phase optimization where circles are first packed with equal radii before relaxing into independent radii.
Implement Gaussian perturbation of the best packing with a decaying standard deviation to find better local optima.
Implement incremental circle addition by growing a packing from n=1 to 32, using the best previous step as the starting point for the next.
Implement an adaptive perturbation strategy by randomly relocating a variable number of circle centers (1 to n/8) and adjusting this count based on a sliding window acceptance rate.
Implement a simulated annealing strategy where each iteration produces a local optimum via SLSQP, which is then perturbed and re-optimized to explore the landscape.
Implement monotonic basin hopping from the incumbent by perturbing 1-3 random circles in each iteration and accepting improvements.
Implement analytic Jacobians for both the objective and the constraints to speed up the SLSQP solver significantly.
Implement parallel-seeded perturbation of the best packing found in the first half of the time budget to refine the solution.
Implement a batch of vectorised penalty starts by using a simplified gradient-based optimization for many random configurations simultaneously, then refining the best ones.
Introduce hexagonal lattice and grid seeds with small jitter to diversify starting configurations for the packing.
Fix the ValueError in _solve_once by flattening the pts array before concatenation so that all components have the same number of dimensions.
Fix the ValueError in _solve_once by flattening the pts array before concatenation so that all components have the same number of dimensions.
Add a polishing pass to the best result that greedily grows each radius until it hits a boundary or a neighbor.
Implement early termination for SLSQP restarts by monitoring the radius sum in a callback to discard unpromising trajectories early.
Draw initial radii from a distribution based on the average area density to encourage heterogeneous circle sizes.
Implement a local linear programming polish using scipy.optimize.linprog to refine the packing after the SLSQP optimization.
Implement an adaptive MAX_ITER strategy that adjusts the iteration budget based on the measured execution time of the first two SLSQP restarts to fit more restarts into the time limit.
Use a Beta(0.8, 0.8) distribution for initial centers to bias circle placement towards the edges and corners, which is a common property of optimal packings.
Increase MAX_ITER to 1000 and add ftol=1e-12 to the SLSQP options to improve convergence precision.
Implement a perturbation-based search where the best packing is iteratively jittered with a decaying standard deviation to explore the local neighborhood.
Implement bimodal radius starts where a random fraction of circles are initialized with a larger radius (0.09) than the rest (0.03).
Implement a strategy where we solve for n+1 circles and then attempt to find the best packing of n circles by deleting one circle from each possibility.
Implement a Riesz-energy repulsion pre-spreading step using L-BFGS-B to better distribute circle centers before the SLSQP phase.
Implement an elite pool and crossover strategy to combine spatial layouts of top-performing packings.
Implement scrambled Halton sequence starts for circle centers to improve diversity and coverage of the search space.
Fix the NameError by replacing the incorrect `seed` reference with the `rng` object's state in the Halton sequence start.
Replace the linear objective with a power-mean objective -sum(r^p) and anneal p from 0.5 to 1.0 over three stages to encourage better spreading of radii.
Replace the linear objective with a power-mean objective -sum(r^p) and anneal p from 0.5 to 1.0 over three stages to encourage better spreading of radii.
Implement farthest-point greedy seeding to produce well-distributed initial centers.
Implement a neighbor-list sparse pair constraints by only including pairs within a distance threshold for the SLSQP constraints to improve speed and stability.
Replace the current _repair loop with a deterministic pass that iteratively shrinks only the smaller radius of a violated pair until feasibility is reached.
Implement an Augmented Lagrangian approach for the non-overlap constraints combined with L-BFGS-B for bound enforcement.
Implement an Augmented Lagrangian approach for the non-overlap constraints combined with L-BFGS-B for bound enforcement.
Implement Lloyd relaxation on the initial centers to spread them into a centroidal-Voronoi-like layout before the SLSQP optimization.
Add a boundary-first ring placement start that places circles along the edges of the square to better initialize the packing.
Diversify lattice starts by randomly choosing grid dimensions and adjusting point counts to reach n.
Implement an evolutionary search over circle centers using SLSQP as a local optimizer and elitist selection.
